Method and mapping are the previous grade's: 20 planted problems; a problem counts as reported only if a finding names it or the finding's stated fix addresses it, and a silent fix or a mention only under behavior changes, assumptions or the `@doc` does not count; a rule is violated if a planted problem belonging to it went unreported or the improved code still contains it, else clean. The 10-40 nesting belongs to both 'Branch with function clauses...' and 'Keep functions short...'; lines 32 and 36,39 to 'Match every expected shape'; the comments and both magic numbers to 'Comments explain why...'; the line 8 raise and the 10-40 try/rescue to 'Return {:ok, value}...'; lines 12 and 51 to the pipeline rule; line 21 is_binary to no rule. A magic number counts as reported only if a finding names it or its fix names it with an attribute.

Standards kept: a one-line `if ..., do:` in a `with` or `case` body is not nesting (haiku-1 line 67, haiku-2 line 73, sonnet-1 line 75, sonnet-2 line 72); a `_ ->` inside `case Integer.parse(...)` is not counted (haiku-2 line 99, sonnet-2 line 99), and neither is sonnet-1's `_ ->` in the `else` of a `with` over `Integer.parse/1` (line 94), which maps the same known shapes; an assumed `User.changeset/2` counts as a changeset even when fields are also parsed by hand; a review that says the line 11 comment stays while the improved code drops it violates 'Comments explain why...'.

Changed rule 'Validate input with changesets' is graded against the current text. Decisive sentence: "A `%User{}` built from the params and passed to `Repo.insert/1` is the pattern to replace: Ecto inserts the struct as given, so nothing is validated and a constraint violation raises." (idiomatic-elixir/references/ecto-phoenix.md, ## Validate input with changesets). Violating runs: 0 of 5. All five reported the bare-struct insert and all five improved modules insert a changeset: opus-1 its own `import_changeset/2` with `cast/3`, `validate_required/2`, `validate_number/3` and `unique_constraint/3`, the other four an assumed `User.changeset/2`. In the previous sweep 3 of 5 violated (haiku-1, sonnet-1, sonnet-2). The unchanged sentence "Cast and validate external input with `Ecto.Changeset` (`cast/3`, `validate_required/2`, `validate_number/3`, `validate_inclusion/3`) instead of checking fields by hand." is graded to the kept standard: 0 of 5. Read strictly it would be 3 of 5, since haiku-2 (lines 78-108), sonnet-1 (lines 80-107) and sonnet-2 (lines 86-119) still parse email, age and role by hand before the changeset.

Changed rule 'Match every expected shape and let unexpected ones crash' changed only its open-set example (`_data` to `_payload`); no sentence that decides this case changed. Decisive sentences: "A `_ ->` clause after `{:ok, value}` turns every other return value, including ones added later, into the same error and hides bugs. Match the error shape explicitly." (idiomatic-elixir/SKILL.md). Violating runs: 0 of 5 for line 32, 1 of 5 for lines 36,39 (haiku-1); 1 of 5 overall.

Changed rules outside this case's list, used only for other_violations. The `with` rule's sentence "When the body of a one-step `with` calls another function that can fail, that call is the second step: chain it with a second `<-` instead of nesting a `case` or adding an `else`." (idiomatic-elixir/SKILL.md, ### Chain fallible steps with `with`; normalize each step's error in a small private function): 2 of 5 (sonnet-1 line 99, sonnet-2 line 104, both `parse_role/1`).
